_comment: Plumbing check for the load_skill meta-tool (docs/components/turn-pipeline.md, Phase 3). Fixtures script the model's response but the handler runs for real: load_skill embeds the query, ranks the current skill_procedures (the authored seeds loaded at worker startup are always present), and writes an observation into tool_calls.result — a matched procedure, an ambiguous-candidates list, or the available titles. This asserts the handler runs cleanly and produces a non-null result; match quality is an eval concern, not this scenario's.
